data.gender_notes: Hershel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hershel is a Hebrew name meaning 'ruler of the army'. It is derived from the Hebrew word 'hersh' which means 'army'. In the Bible, Hershel is not specifically mentioned, but there are several biblical figures with similar names, such as Hershel Shalmaneser and Hershel the Great. The name Hershel carries the meaning “Ruler of the army” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hershel usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler of the army and live with faith, good character and purpose.
